## load packages and data

```{r message=F}
rm(list = ls())

library(lavaan) # v.0.6-21
library(pheatmap) # v.1.0.12
library(here) # v.1.0.1
library(dplyr) # v.1.2.1 

## pick depending on residualized or normal timeseries
load(here("Analysis_data", "df.Rda"))
#load(here("Analysis_data", "df_rawfunc.Rda"))
#df <- df_rawfunc

df <- rename(df, "SI" = "–SI")
```


## Coupling and Intelligence

```{r}
SCFC_int_model <- '
## coupling model
coupling =~ NA*SI + PT + RE + C
coupling ~~ 1*coupling
C ~~ 0*C
SI ~~ PT

## intelligence model
int =~ NA*BIS + equal("int=~BIS")*APM
int ~~ 1*int

BIS =~ NA*PC_Mean + PS_Mean + C_Mean + M_Mean
BIS ~~ 1*BIS

APM =~ NA*PropCorrOdd + equal("APM=~PropCorrOdd")*PropCorrEven
APM ~~ 1*APM


## structural model
int ~ coupling
'

fit_SCFC_int <- cfa(SCFC_int_model, data = df, std.lv = T, 
                      missing = "ML")

summary(fit_SCFC_int, fit.measures = T, standardized = TRUE)
zFit <- standardizedSolution(fit_SCFC_int)
zFit_unstandardized <- parameterEstimates(fit_SCFC_int)

regressions <- subset(zFit, op == "~")

loadings <- subset(zFit, op == "=~")
loadings_unstandardized <- subset(zFit_unstandardized, op == "=~")

error_var <- subset(zFit, op == "~~" & lhs == rhs)
error_var_unstandardized <- subset(zFit_unstandardized, op == "~~" & lhs == rhs)

```

## heat map of indicators

```{r}
cor_mat <- cor(df[,c(10:18,20:21)], method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)  # Adjust colors as needed
breaks_seq <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = length(my_palette) + 1)

cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)] <- NA
cor_mat <- cor_mat[, ncol(cor_mat):1]

# add reliabilities to diagonal
squared_loadings <- loadings_unstandardized$est^2
squared_loadings <- squared_loadings[c(1:4)]
errorvars <- error_var_unstandardized$est[6:8] # select -SI, PT, RE
errorvars <- c(errorvars, 0)

varT <- 1 # variance of the latent variable is set to 1 in model specification
rels <- (squared_loadings*varT)/(squared_loadings*varT + errorvars)

x <- c(NA, rels, 0.77, 0.47, 0.44, 0.60, 0.87, 0.87) # added Chronbachs alpha for BIS variables and Split half reliability for APM
n <- nrow(cor_mat)



cor_mat[cbind(1:n, n:1)] <- round(x, 2)
cor_mat <- as.data.frame(cor_mat)

num_mat <- round(cor_mat,2)
num_mat[is.na(num_mat)] <- ""

rownames(cor_mat) <- c("DE", "–SI", "PT", "RE", "C", "BIS PC", "BIS PS", "BIS C", "BIS M", "APM Odd", "APM Even")
colnames(cor_mat) <- rev(c("DE", "–SI", "PT", "RE", "C", "BIS PC", "BIS PS", "BIS C", "BIS M", "APM Odd", "APM Even"))

manifest_cors <- pheatmap(cor_mat,    
          cluster_rows = FALSE,  
          cluster_cols = FALSE,
         na_col = "white",
         display_numbers = num_mat,
         #gaps_row = c(10,20),
         #gaps_col = c(10,20),
         border_color = NA,
         angle_col = "315",
         breaks = breaks_seq)

png(here("Figures", "STATS04_heatmap.png"), width = 5.5, height = 4.5, units = "in", res = 600)
print(manifest_cors)
dev.off()
```


## fix non-significant regression path to zero to see whether this worsens fit

```{r}
SCFC_int_model_reg0 <- '
## coupling model
coupling =~ NA*SI + PT + RE + C
coupling ~~ 1*coupling
C ~~ 0*C
SI ~~ PT

## intelligence model
int =~ NA*BIS + equal("int=~BIS")*APM
int ~~ 1*int

BIS =~ NA*PC_Mean + PS_Mean + C_Mean + M_Mean
BIS ~~ 1*BIS

APM =~ NA*PropCorrOdd + equal("APM=~PropCorrOdd")*PropCorrEven
APM ~~ 1*APM


## structural model
int ~ 0*coupling
'

fit_SCFC_int_reg0 <- cfa(SCFC_int_model_reg0, data = df, std.lv = T, 
                      missing = "ML")

summary(fit_SCFC_int_reg0, fit.measures = T, standardized = TRUE)

anova(fit_SCFC_int, fit_SCFC_int_reg0)
```
